svg.text: ABAN — WHAT THE ORIGINAL MODEL WAS MISSING

Left: the original model scaled ×2.505 to real size (as modelled it is 36.9 mm wide and holds 2.28 ml). Orange = open surfaces, not solids. Right: the 2026 model, same plane and scale. Measured on the model.
ORIGINAL ×2.505
2026 MODEL
FINDINGS → 2026 MODEL
Not at real scale: 36.9 × 10.5 × 28.5 mm of glass holding 2.28
ml.
→ Scaled ×2.505 (set by the thinnest wall reaching 2.0 mm);
33.23 ml brimful, 30 ml fill.
Glass is 7 open surfaces (184–264 open edges each); bell and
base are tessellated separately and never meet.
→ Bell and base stitched along their shared edge (346 splits,
max move 0.0042 mm); one watertight solid of 56.3 cm³.
Front/back walls 0.82–1.08 below the shoulder, 0.45 at it;
sides 5.6; base 5.3.
→ Original inner skin kept and pushed to ≥ 2.1 where thinner:
measured min 2.10 (sampled), base 13.3.
No neck finish: a flattened 6.9 × 2.4 stub; the cap collar
sits 1.28 into it.
→ Flat land + Ø10.0 ground neck, 1:10 bore; stopper head 0.30
above the lip.
At the land the bell is only 13.9 deep at real scale: less
than a 16.3 FEA 15 crimp ferrule before any glass.
→ Splash extrait, the original cap as a jewelled stopper:
proportions unchanged.
Bottle passes into its holder (1167 crossing triangle pairs);
nothing touches its base (3.6 gap at real scale).
→ Holder pocketed (min 0.40 clearance); bottle rests on a
velvet seat pad.
Holder sinks 2.59 (real scale) into the stand, which is an
open surface.
→ Holder raised onto the stand top.
Box: 17 of 17 panels are open single sheets (1.0 thick as
drawn).
→ At real scale 2.5: a rigid-box board (2.0 greyboard + wrap).
Panels kept as drawn.
OPEN (not claimed)
• Stopper sealing for transit (ground glass vs PTFE sleeve,
capsule) to validate with the glassmaker.
• Wall distribution depends on the glass process (press-and-blow
vs blow-and-blow): confirm with the supplier.
• Decoration process for gold lines and lotus (applied metal vs
precious-metal lustre) not specified.
• Box closed-lid clearance to the stopper not checked (lid
modelled open); hinge and closure not detailed.
MALINYX · ABAN
Source audit → 2026 model
SHEET 2/2 · A3 · mm
2026-10-02 · concept engineering
